title: Multiresidue Methods for the Determination of Organo Phosphorus Compounds (Monochrotophos, Anilophos, Phosalone, Temphos, Isazophos, Triazophos and Chlorpyrifos)
clause_1_scope: This standard prescribes a HPLC/GLC method for the determination of organophosphorus pesticide (multiresidue method) residues at sub ppm levels in food commodities, after appropriate sample preparation and clean-up.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Methods of sampling for determination of pesticide residues in agricultural and food commodities, (IS 11380 (PART 1))

clause_3_terminology: Multiresidue Methods for the Determination of Organo Phosphorus Compounds

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
